subject: pharmacology
title: NSAIDs and antipyretic analgesics

steps.tx: **NSAIDs** inhibit cyclooxygenase enzymes that convert arachidonic acid into prostaglandins in tissues. **Prostaglandins** drive pain, fever and inflammation, so blocking their production relieves all three together. One enzyme form protects the stomach mucosa, platelets and kidney perfusion continuously. The other form appears mainly at inflamed sites, yet it also functions in kidney and endothelium. Every benefit and harm of this class follows which enzyme the drug blocks and for how long.
steps.say: These drugs inhibit cyclooxygenase enzymes that convert arachidonic acid into prostaglandins in tissues. Prostaglandins drive pain, fever and inflammation so blocking their production relieves all three together. One enzyme form protects the stomach and kidneys while the other form dominates inflamed sites. Every benefit and harm follows which enzyme the drug blocks in each patient.

steps.tx: Nonselective agents such as **ibuprofen**, naproxen and diclofenac relieve musculoskeletal pain and dysmenorrhoea effectively. They also erode **gastric protection**, so ulcers and bleeding follow, especially with age, steroids, anticoagulants or alcohol. Enteric coating and proton pump cover reduce the risk but they never abolish it completely. **Aspirin** uniquely acetylates the enzyme irreversibly, so platelet inhibition lasts the entire platelet lifespan. That permanent platelet effect powers low dose aspirin for arterial protection in cardiology.
steps.say: Nonselective agents such as ibuprofen are used to relieve musculoskeletal pain and dysmenorrhoea in many patients every day. They also erode gastric protection so ulcers and bleeding follow in susceptible patients taking them. Age, steroids, anticoagulants and alcohol raise the risk of bleeding considerably during treatment overall. Aspirin acetylates the enzyme irreversibly so platelet inhibition lasts the entire platelet lifespan afterwards.

right.title: COX 2 selective (celecoxib)
points: Fewer ulcers, but cardiovascular risk remains

steps.tx: This endoscopic image shows an **antral gastric ulcer** with a pale base and raised inflamed margins. The surrounding mucosa looks red and swollen because widespread **gastritis** accompanies the ulcer crater. Loss of protective prostaglandins after nonselective treatment explains why the antrum suffers this injury pattern. Examiners expect you to connect epigastric pain and bleeding in a treated patient with mucosal defence failure. Stopping the offending drug and adding acid suppression allows the ulcer to heal.
steps.say: This endoscopic image shows an antral gastric ulcer with a pale base and inflamed margins surrounding it. The surrounding mucosa looks red and swollen because widespread gastritis accompanies the ulcer crater visible. Loss of protective prostaglandins explains why the antrum suffers this injury pattern after treatment ends. Examiners expect you to connect epigastric pain and bleeding with mucosal defence failure here. Stopping the offending drug allows the ulcer to heal with acid suppression given.

steps.tx: Selective **COX 2 inhibitors** such as celecoxib spare gastric protection and platelets at usual doses. They cut ulcer complications, but endothelial prostacyclin suppression without platelet thromboxane blockade tilts the balance toward **thrombosis**. That imbalance explains why rofecoxib left the market after cardiovascular harm emerged clearly. Every drug in this class can raise blood pressure, retain salt and water, and precipitate heart failure or kidney injury. Dehydration, cirrhosis and heart failure make the kidney depend on protective prostaglandins.
steps.say: Selective inhibitors such as celecoxib spare gastric protection and platelets at usual therapeutic doses given. They cut ulcer complications but they tilt the vascular balance toward thrombosis in patients treated. Endothelial prostacyclin falls while platelet thromboxane continues and that imbalance promotes arterial clotting events. Every drug in this class can raise blood pressure and retain salt and water. Dehydration makes the kidney depend on prostaglandins so injury follows more easily there.

steps.tx: **Paracetamol** relieves pain and fever centrally with negligible peripheral anti inflammatory action in tissues. It causes no platelet or gastric harm at therapeutic doses, so clinicians favour it in pregnancy and ulcer risk. Excess dose saturates conjugation pathways and shunts metabolism toward toxic **NAPQI** inside hepatocytes. That metabolite depletes glutathione and it causes centrilobular liver necrosis in severe overdose. N acetylcysteine replenishes glutathione and it saves the liver when teams give it early.
steps.say: Paracetamol is used to relieve pain and fever centrally with negligible peripheral anti inflammatory action in tissues overall. It causes no platelet or gastric harm at therapeutic doses in most patients treated safely. Excess dose shunts metabolism toward toxic metabolite formation inside hepatocytes during severe overdose episodes alone. That metabolite depletes glutathione and it causes centrilobular liver necrosis without early treatment given. Acetylcysteine replenishes glutathione and it saves the liver when teams give it early.

steps.tx: Aspirin in children with viral illness risks **Reye syndrome**, which combines liver failure with encephalopathy. Paediatric fever therefore uses paracetamol or ibuprofen instead of aspirin in routine practice. **NSAID exacerbated respiratory disease** links aspirin sensitivity, asthma and nasal polyps through leukotriene shunting in airways. In pregnancy, these drugs after mid gestation risk premature ductus closure and low amniotic fluid. Low dose aspirin paradoxically protects high risk mothers against pre eclampsia when treatment starts early.
steps.say: Aspirin in children with viral illness is linked to a syndrome that combines liver failure with encephalopathy dangerously. Paediatric fever is therefore treated with paracetamol or ibuprofen instead of aspirin in routine clinical practice today. These drugs can worsen aspirin sensitive asthma because leukotriene production rises in the airways afterwards. In pregnancy these drugs are linked to premature ductus closure and low amniotic fluid after mid gestation. Low dose aspirin protects high risk mothers against pre eclampsia when treatment starts early.
